author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal + QHC (quadratic term after RegCal) — alpha_init=0.3 — seed=42
abstract: Sensitivity ablation for Quadratic Head Calibration (QHC): increase alpha_init from 0.2 to 0.3 to test stronger second‑order contribution after RegCal for regression-family tasks. Classification heads unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from hdp_regcal_quad_head import create_network, create_optimizer

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        "learning_rate": 0.001,
        "hidden_dim": 256,
        "kernel_size": 7,
        "dropout_rate": 0.10,
        "ds_dilations": [1,2,4,8,16],
        "head_hidden_reg": 128,
        "head_hidden_cls": 128,
        "head_dropout": 0.05,
        "regcal_on": True,
        "motif_k": 5,
        "quad_alpha_init": 0.3,
    }
